exposure: timing of ultrasound examination postpartum (6 weeks, 6 months, 12 months)
outcome: ultrasound indicators of CSD (defect depth, residual muscle thickness, residual muscle ratio)
diagnostic sensitivity and specificity of CSD diagnosis
cohort: The study included 120 women who delivered by elective Cesarean section with single and term births between January 2021 and June 2022.
finding: CSD evaluation at 6 weeks postpartum may lead to misdiagnosis or overdiagnosis, and diagnosis of CSD is more accurately made at 6 months or longer postpartum.
